comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 detects a comment introducing a specific, checkable external fact (statistic, study, law) that is not in the OP text. Item 1 detects a comment quoting or referencing a specific element of the OP's title or argument. Item 0 excludes facts the OP already stated, so its target is new external content. Item 1 targets OP text itself. They also use different empty-list and null rules.
